run.name: Hudbay Minerals Inc.
run.title: CP-OS host session (HBM)
run.summary: Hudbay has a sound credit profile on reported figures: debt of USD 860.2 million against trailing adjusted EBITDA of USD 1,271.6 million, no funded maturity before 2028. Thin committed liquidity and Arizona capital needs limit it. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Revenue, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: Adjusted EBITDA (company, non-GAAP), as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Total long-term debt 860.2 and company net debt (80.5) over company LTM adjusted EBITDA 1,271.6 (PR-Q2 page:6, page:24-25). Carrying value, not principal (principal 866.4). Company net debt deducts all cash of 890.9, including 334.5 held by Copper World LLC. EBITDA is a non-GAAP management measure; no covenant definition is supplied

cash.basis: Cash. Company total liquidity 1,044.6 (PR-Q2 page:6). Undrawn is 450.0 less 272.0 drawn less 24.3 letters of credit. Cash includes 334.5 held by Copper World LLC and restricted to the project; excludes 49.8 of restricted municipal bond proceeds. The split of availability between the Canadian and Peruvian facilities is not printed

cashflow.basis: Operating cash flow before change in working capital, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Covenant levels, debt documents, ownership data and anything after 2026-07-29 are not supplied, and trailing earnings are the company's own non-GAAP measure.
CP-1 main limitation: No covenant level, full-year cash interest or audited FY2025 statement is supplied, and trailing earnings are a management measure.
